The '''Hall of Arms''' wing of [[Northshire Abbey]], located in [[Northshire Valley]] in [[Elwynn Forest]], is home to both the [[paladin]] and [[warrior]] trainers for the least experienced of the Stormwind Army recruits. It is situated south of the [[Main Hall (Northshire)|Main Hall]], and the [[Library Wing (Northshire)|Library Wing]] lies on the opposite side of the Abbey.
